body: Ragazzo, But it happens when we have a viaTable (many to many) relation only. In other cases this method works fine.

@qiangxue can you fix [here](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/db/BaseActiveRecord.php#L1094) quotes so we can get correct formatting on github ? I also dont think that escaping too much helps here for readability .

@codru true , however making something like `$tag->assignNode($node)` in `addTags` method complitly saves you from unexpected `link` method behavior. 
So overall my suggetsion is better then using `afterSave` or other methods to do some logic. or using `link` method .
